tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-4. ATLAS IS AT $45.57. AND DREW JUST SPENT NINE DOLLARS FAAB ON ROMAN WILSON. I AM NOT SAYING THAT IS THE WRONG CALL. I AM SAYING IT IS THE MOST ATLAS THING THAT HAS EVER HAPPENED ON THIS EXCHANGE.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Week 3 Ledger is going to have to reckon with a lot: Wingard leading Fronge early, Brent opening on Charles again, and Adam currently scoring on Ryan after that 71-point Week 2. The headline is writing itself and it is not kind to anyone's preseason thesis.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: My lock hit last week. Brent covered. Two lock wins on the season now and I ranked Brent ninth in my internal model, which means the lesson I am taking from this is that I should trust my model less and lock chalk more.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Mitchum ceiling wrong last week and I am not hiding from it. What I will say is that Jake is up 34.8-1.5 on Mitchum right now, and whoever called Jake directionless after a 97-point Week 2 should probably revisit that before the final whistle.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Kevin vs Shaq is sitting at 19.1-6.6 and nobody is talking about it. Kevin is 2-2 after getting fed to a 205-point Crownline buzzsaw and is still punching. Redline at $86.58 is quietly becoming one of the more interesting prices on the board.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Adam is sitting at 24.9 points on Ryan in a live game right now, and my lock this week is not Adam. I will not say more than that.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Three missed locks last week, Terrence is 5-7, and somehow the conversation this morning is about whether I ranked Ryan too high at third. He is $129.22 on the exchange, 136 points in Week 2, and hasn't been beaten yet. The rankings are fine. The picks board is not.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Terrence is at 5-7 and just described his lock record as 'the part that matters.' I want a full segment on what the other part is, because I am 8-4 with two lock hits and nobody has asked me a single question this morning.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: My Charles lock hit. I am 5-7 on the season, yes, but I want it noted that the lock was correct and that is the part that matters to me personally and professionally.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Brent opened 21-0 on Charles last week and it finished with Charles winning by how much, exactly? I am not going to pretend Sunday mornings in this league teach the same lesson twice, but I am also not going to pretend they don't teach the same lesson twice.
